item.title: Mothers still lack support to breastfeed, UN warns
item.description: Breastfeeding rates are rising worldwide, but millions of mothers and families still lack the services and protection they need to feed their babies safely, the UN has warned.

item.title: DR Congo: New centre opens at heart of record Ebola outbreak
item.description: New UN-backed centres will serve eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as confirmed Ebola cases continued to climb sharply over the weekend in the largest ever outbreak of the highly contagious disease in the country.

item.title: In Somalia, AI is helping deliver food to hungry families
item.description: Amid a deepening hunger crisis in Somalia, artificial intelligence (AI) is helping to deliver aid to the people who need it most.

item.title: Israel violates Lebanese airspace, kills over two dozen in Gaza in weekend strikes
item.description: Israeli forces reportedly killed more than two dozen Palestinians in Gaza and violated Lebanese airspace more than 100 times over the weekend despite ongoing ceasefire agreements, UN agencies and peacekeepers said on Monday.

item.title: Drone strikes threaten civilians and aid operations in Sudan
item.description: Drone strikes are posing deadly risks to civilians in Sudan and hampering humanitarian efforts to reach them as attacks continue to affect conflict-hit areas, the UN aid coordination office OCHA said on Monday.

item.title: Accepting What It Cannot Control, CARICOM Focuses on What It Can
item.description: Unable to influence wars, global fuel prices or supply chain disruptions, Caribbean leaders are focusing on strengthening the systems that will make the region more resilient.
